title: Approval of Termination of Lease of W-4 of Dorkas Ramirez, Ramirez Toys
text:
[El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument (Olvera Street), 125 Paseo de la Plaza]
Approval of Termination of Lease of W-4 of Dorkas Ramirez, Ramirez Toys
summary: El Pueblo's commission is asked to approve terminating the lease for Ramirez Toys, a concession at the Olvera Street historic monument.

locations.text: El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument (Olvera Street)

details.action: Approval of termination of lease of W-4 (Ramirez Toys)

flag.reason: Ends a long-standing Olvera Street concession inside the El Pueblo historic plaza in Downtown.
